name: Diamantinasaurus
sum: Diamantinasaurus is a titanosaur from the Winton Formation of Queensland, Australia, named in 2009 and found beside Australovenator.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; the holotype and a second specimen were found together over four seasons near Winton.
material: The holotype and a second specimen; the second specimen was described in 2021.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Hocknull et al. 2009
